fields.details:
BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN NURSING (B.Sc Nursing)
Woodland Institute of Nursing believes that Basic B.Sc Nursing program will impart nursing knowledge and practical training to enhance the nursing profession by developing competencies and skills required to meet the ever-advancing medical science and provide quality care to individuals in health and illness. The institute believes that graduate nurses will become responsible citizens capable of delivering quality nursing care locally and globally.
Aims

Woodland Institute of Nursing is committed to providing quality programmes in nursing education, research and service that anticipate and respond to the continuing evolution of the health care industry.

Objectives

On completion of Basic B.Sc. Nursing degree programme the graduates will be able to:

  • Apply knowledge from physical, biological and behavioural sciences, medicine and nursing in providing nursing care to individuals, families and communities.
  • Demonstrate understanding of lifestyle and other factors affecting the health of individuals and groups.
  • Provide nursing care based on the steps of the nursing process in collaboration with individuals and groups.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking skills in making decisions in various health care situations.
  • Utilize modern trends and technology in providing health care services.
  • Provide promotive, preventive and restorative health services according to national health policies and programmes.
  • Practice within the framework of professional ethics and legal boundaries.
  • Communicate effectively with individuals, groups and members of the health team.
  • Demonstrate teaching skills for individuals and groups in clinical and community health settings.
  • Participate effectively as a member of the health care team.
  • Demonstrate leadership and managerial skills in clinical and community settings.
  • Conduct need-based research and utilize research findings to improve nursing care.
  • Participate in professional organizations for personal and professional development.
Mission & Vision

To establish the institute as a centre of excellence in nursing education, nursing service, research and administration at the state and national level through quality education and professional development.

Woodland Institute of Nursing strives to provide the best education that combines continuous quality improvement and prepares individuals who are professionally competent and ethically responsible.

Course Offered & Duration

Woodland Institute of Nursing offers Basic B.Sc Nursing, a four (4) year course with an intake of 40 candidates annually in the month of June. Candidates must complete the application process immediately after selection.

Eligibility For Admission
  • Age ΓÇô Minimum 17 to 25 years on or before 31st December of the year of admission.
  • Admission eligible for female candidates.
  • Educational Qualification ΓÇô 10+2 (Science) with 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English (PCBE).
  • 40% aggregate marks for ST/SC/OBC candidates.

fields.full_name: POST BASIC BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN NURSING
fields.details:
POST BASIC B.SC NURSING (P.B.B.Sc Nursing)
This Institution believes that Post Basic B.Sc Nursing program will impart nursing knowledge and practical training to enhance the nursing profession by developing competencies and skills required to meet the ever-advancing medical sciences in the care of individuals during illness and health. The institute also believes that graduate nurses will become productive citizens capable of providing quality nursing care locally and globally.
Aims

Woodland Institute of Nursing is committed to providing quality programmes in nursing education, research and service that anticipate and respond to the continuing evolution of the health care industry.

Objectives

On completion of the Post Basic B.Sc Nursing degree programme the graduates will be able to:

  • Assess health status, identify nursing needs, plan, implement and evaluate nursing care for patients and clients contributing to the health of individuals, families and communities.
  • Demonstrate competency in nursing techniques based on concepts and principles from nursing, physical, biological and behavioural sciences.
  • Participate as members of the health team in promotive, preventive, curative and restorative health care delivery systems.
  • Demonstrate effective communication and interpersonal relationship skills.
  • Demonstrate leadership qualities and decision-making abilities in various clinical situations.
  • Demonstrate teaching skills for individuals and groups in community health settings.
  • Demonstrate managerial skills in community health settings.
  • Practice ethical values in personal and professional life.
  • Conduct need-based research studies and utilize research findings to improve the quality of nursing care.
  • Participate in professional nursing associations for professional growth and development.
Mission

To establish the institute as a centre of excellence in nursing education, nursing service, research and administration at the state and national level through quality education, professional development and research.

Vision

Woodland Institute of Nursing strives to provide the best education that combines continuous quality improvement and prepares individuals who are professionally capable of upholding ethical and professional values.

Course Offered & Duration

The Institute offers Post Basic B.Sc Nursing, a two (2) year course with an intake of thirty (30) candidates annually in the month of June. Male candidates are also eligible for the course.

Eligibility For Admission

To be eligible for admission to this course, a candidate shall have:

  • Passed Higher Secondary / Senior Secondary / Intermediate / 10+2 or an equivalent examination recognized by the university. Candidates who completed 10+1 on or before 1986 are also eligible.
  • Obtained a certificate in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) and registered as R.N.R.M with the State Nurses Registration Council.

GENERAL NURSING & MIDWIFERY (G.N.M)
Modern nursing is a dynamic, therapeutic and educative process in meeting the health needs of the individuals, the family and the community. Nursing is one of the health professions which function in conjunction with other health care agencies in assisting individuals, families and communities to achieve and maintain desirable standards of health. The Woodland Institute of Nursing believes in the concepts of health laid down by the World Health Organization (WHO) i.e. ΓÇ£Health is state of complete physical, mental and social well being and not merely the absence of the disease or infirmity.ΓÇ¥
Philosophy

Modern nursing is a dynamic, therapeutic and educative process in meeting the health needs of the individuals, the family and the community. Nursing is one of the health professions which function in conjunction with other health care agencies in assisting individuals, families and communities to achieve and maintain desirable standards of health.

The Woodland Institute of Nursing believes in the concepts of health laid down by the World Health Organization (WHO) i.e. ΓÇ£Health is state of complete physical, mental and social well being and not merely the absence of the disease or infirmity.ΓÇ¥

Since nurses provided and will undoubtedly continue to provide a large part of health care, their training should equip them professional expertise to meet the changing demands of society and their expanding role therein. To achieve this, emphasis must be laid to impart the knowledge and skill most relevant to the health care needs of the community and the country as a whole. This must also be accompanied by a corresponding change in professional attitudes.

Indian Nursing Council recognized that basic Nursing Education is a formally recognized programme of study providing a broad and sound foundation in the behavioral, life and Nursing science for the general practice of Nursing, for leadership role and for the Post basic Education in specialties for advanced nursing practice. The Council believes that this basic course in nursing should prepare nurse for occupying first level position in nursing in all kind of health care settings.

The council recognizes that Nursing is a profession which is influenced by advances in science and Technology. It believes that skills in all aspect of communication are also essential for learning and for the practice of nursing.

The Institute also recognizes that nature of nursing is such that a substantial portion of learning of the students is acquired in the clinical fields of practice. It further recognizes the independence of nursing and allied professions and occupations in promoting, maintaining and restoring health and prevention of diseases.

The Institute believes that it has a responsibility in helping the students to develop pride in their profession besides keeping them abreast with current knowledge and professional trends for a successful career ahead.

Aims

The aims of the Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery programme are:

  • To prepare nurses with a sound educational programme in nursing to enable them to function as efficient members of the health team, beginning with the competencies for first level positions in all kinds of health care settings.
  • To help nurses develop an ability to cooperate and coordinate with members of the health team in the prevention of disease, promotion of health and rehabilitation of the sickness.
  • To help nurses in their personal and professional development, so that they are able to make maximum contribution to the society as useful and productive individuals, citizens as well efficient nurses.
  • To serve as a base for further professional education and specialization in nursing.
  • To prepare nurses to keep pace with latest professional and technological developments and use these for providing nursing services.
Objectives

The nurses on the completion of this course will be able to:

  • Demonstrate competency in providing health care to individual, sick or well using nursing process.
  • Assess the nursing need of clients from birth to death.
  • Plan and carry out appropriate action to meet nursing needs.
  • Provide effective nursing care for maintaining best possible level of health in all aspects.
  • Promote self care in people under their care.
  • Apply problem solving techniques in nursing practice.
  • Evaluate effectiveness of nursing care.
  • Apply knowledge from the humanities, biological & behavioral sciences in functioning as a nurse.
  • Function effectively with members of the health team and community applying the knowledge of human relation skills in her work.
  • Participate as member of health team in delivery of curative, preventive, promotive and rehabilitative health care services.
  • Mobilize community resources and their involvement in working with the communities.
  • Demonstrate use of ethical values in their personal and professional life.
  • Demonstrate interest in activities of professional organizations.
  • Recognize the need for continuing education for professional development.
  • Demonstrate basic skills in teaching patients and giving nursing care to them.
  • Demonstrate basic skills in administration and leadership while working with other members of health team and community.
  • Assist in research activities.
Course Offered

The school offers the course of General Nursing and Midwifery (G.N.M) for 3 (three) years. Limited seats of 50 (fifty) students will be admitted annually in the month of September every year.

Eligibility For Admission
  • Age - 17 to 35 years.
  • Sex - Female preferably unmarried / widow / divorce without encumbrance will also be considered.
  • Education Qualification: 10+2 Science / Arts / Commerce with 40% aggregate.

Library & E-Library

Library

Woodland Institute of Nursing Library provides vital support for students and staff, complementing academic activities. We arrange access to the world of information ΓÇô whether online, multimedia or in print ΓÇô and the training and support to exploit it to the full.

The Library is well equipped with latest Nursing books, nursing journals, newspapers, and magazines. It is a well-established library with adequate lighting facility, proper ventilation and separate reading area for both students and faculty.

The library has been automated with Koha Integrated Library Software in the year 2016 and most of our library services are carried out using this software.

The Library holds vast collections of nursing as well as non-nursing books. Books are classified using DDC 23rd edition. Ordering and placement of books are usually done at the beginning of the session.

With the objective of inculcating reading habits among students and staff, the Library tries its best to indent latest and new editions of nursing books as well as non-fiction books annually.

The Library Committee along with the Head of each department sits and decides on the selection and purchase of books.

E-Library

The library is equipped with a well-organized and modern E-Library that supports digital learning and academic excellence.

In the month of June 2025, the library subscribed to both e-books and e-journals which includes:

EBSCO eBooks Nursing Collection consisting of 800+ titles and J-Gate Nursing Subset consisting of 635+ full-text journals and 344+ indexed journals.

The library also has an Internet browsing area with a seating capacity for 10 students.

The E-Library plays a vital role in encouraging independent learning, research orientation, and lifelong learning skills, ensuring that students stay updated with the latest advancements in nursing education and healthcare practices.

Clinical Areas

StudentsΓÇÖ clinical experience will be conducted in various Government and Private Hospitals in Shillong. The hospitals and training areas are as follows:

  • Woodland Hospital, Shillong
  • NEIGRIHMS, Shillong
  • Civil Hospital, Shillong
  • Ganesh Das Hospital, Shillong
  • San-ker Hospital, Shillong
  • Nazareth Hospital, Shillong
  • Urban and Rural areas for Community Posting

Transport Facility

At present, the college has 5 buses, 1 Traveller and 1 Bolero for transport of students to the hospitals, community centres and other clinical training areas. The transport facility ensures safe and timely movement of students to and from the hostel/Institute for clinical postings.

In the near future, the Institute will procure more vehicles as per the requirement to strengthen and expand transportation facilities.

5

Buses

1

Traveller

1

Bolero

Hostel Rules & Necessities

Hostel Rules & Discipline

  • Hostel occupancy is compulsory. Hostel rules and regulations will be detailed at the time of allotment of hostel seat.
  • College and hostel premises are guarded by security personnel round the clock.
  • Students are not permitted to use mobile phones while in class or on clinical duty.
  • Good communal harmony and interpersonal relationship must be maintained among students.
  • Drugs, alcohol and other addictive substances are strictly prohibited.
  • Any student found guilty of ragging in any form will be expelled from the Institute.
  • Violation of rules will attract disciplinary action according to the discretion of the college authority.
  • All decisions taken by the college authority are final and binding.

Items to Bring

  • Quilt / Blankets
  • Mattress (size 2.5/6 provided by hostel; you may bring your own if preferred)
  • Pillow with pillow case
  • Bed sheets
  • Mosquito net
  • Bucket & Mug
  • Tiffin & Flask
  • Plate, Cup, Glass and Spoon
  • Hot Water Bag
  • Other personal requirements

Instructional Facilities

The qualified nursing, medical and non-medical faculty of the Institute provides high quality programme of study. The method of instruction includes formal lectures, group discussions, laboratory sessions, field work and planned clinical experience under faculty guidance. Provision is also made for individual guidance and various clinical experiences.

  • A candidate must have minimum of 80% attendance (irrespective of the kind of absence) in theory in each subject for appearing for examination.
  • A candidate must have 100% attendance in each of the practical areas before the award of degree.
  • Students will not be allowed to go home midway between the academic sessions, except in cases of emergency as per the PrincipalΓÇÖs decision.
  • A candidate must pass in internal and external examinations in each of the papers separately.

Laboratories

Nursing Foundation Lab

The Institution is equipped with numerous adult mannequins for basic skills training and provides a simulated hospital environment to build confidence for patient care and applied critical thinking using mannequins, beds, and equipment before clinical rotations.

Anatomy & Physiology Lab

The Institution is equipped with human skeletons, 3D models, specimens, and charts. This laboratory helps students acquire a comprehensive knowledge of the normal structure and function of the human body systems.

Computer Lab

The computer lab is a spacious and well-organized facility designed to help students learn essential computer literacy skills. It supports research, presentations, and academic assignments through modern computing systems.

Advanced Nursing Skill Lab

This lab is designed to equip students with core and advanced nursing skills. It simulates a general hospital ward environment with patients and includes adult mannequins (including CPR mannequins), IV arm and infusion models, ventilators, airway management models, and other advanced equipment.

Community Health Nursing Lab

A well-equipped lab that prepares students for public health roles. It includes community bags for home visits, audio-visual aids for planning and conducting mass health education programs, community health teaching models, family planning models, nutrition charts and food models, and growth monitoring tools.

Pediatric Nursing Lab

A specialized lab that focuses on teaching students basic and advanced nursing care for infants, children, and adolescents. It includes newborn care mannequins, infant and pediatric training mannequins, and essential pediatric equipment.

Obstetrics & Gynecology Nursing Lab

An essential skill lab equipped with obstetric delivery simulators, pelvic and pregnancy models, and instruments to provide hands-on practice for nursing students in maternal, newborn, and womenΓÇÖs reproductive health care.

Nutrition Lab

A well-furnished mini kitchen that enables students to learn the principles of dietetics and healthy nutrition as well as gain practical experience in preparing normal and therapeutic diets for various disease conditions.

fields.excerpt:
Woodland Nursing Institute stands as a distinguished centre of nursing education, committed to nurturing competent, compassionate, and professionally accomplished nursing professionals. Established with a vision to serve society through quality healthcare education, the institute believes that nursing is not merely a career but a lifelong service to humanity.

The institute places equal emphasis on academic knowledge and practical application. Through a carefully designed curriculum, students are exposed to modern nursing concepts, evolving healthcare technologies, and evidence-based practices aligned with national and international standards.

With state-of-the-art infrastructure, well-equipped laboratories, simulation facilities, and structured hospital postings, students graduate with confidence, competence, and a deep sense of professional responsibility.

Vision

To be recognised as a leading institution in nursing education by integrating academic excellence, continuous quality improvement, innovation, and value-based learning, thereby producing nursing professionals who are clinically proficient, ethically grounded, socially responsible, and capable of contributing effectively to healthcare systems at local, national, and global levels.

Mission
  • To establish Woodland Nursing Institute as a Centre of Excellence in nursing education at state, national, and international levels.
  • To provide high-quality, student-centred education through a structured, competency-based, and outcome-oriented curriculum.
  • To foster professional growth through skill-based training, ethical nursing practice, leadership development, and lifelong learning.
  • To encourage research-oriented learning, innovation, and evidence-based nursing practices.
  • To instil compassion, discipline, accountability, and commitment towards community health, patient safety, and social wellbeing.
  • To promote community engagement and outreach programmes that address public health needs.

The Institute is affiliated to Martin Luther Christian University (MLCU), Shillong for both Basic B.Sc Nursing and Post B.Sc Nursing courses.

Our Philosophy

Woodland Nursing Institute follows a learner-centric philosophy that recognises every studentΓÇÖs potential to grow into a responsible healthcare professional. The institute promotes values such as respect for human dignity, ethical practice, teamwork, accountability, and service-oriented leadership.

MESSAGE FROM THE DIRECTOR

Excellence in Every Pulse

ΓÇ£The trained nurse has become one of the great blessings of humanity, taking a place beside the physician and the priest.ΓÇ¥ ΓÇö William Osler

Welcome to the Woodland Institute of Nursing, Laitkor.

At Woodland, we view nursing not merely as a career, but as a noble calling. In the rapidly evolving landscape of global healthcare, the demand is no longer just for practitioners, but for clinical leaders who possess the intellectual depth to innovate and the emotional intelligence to heal.

Our institute serves as a bridge between academic rigor and clinical mastery. Nestled in the serene hills of Laitkor, our campus is designed to be a sanctuary for learning, connected to modern medicine through Woodland Hospital.

Whether you are pursuing B.Sc. Nursing, Post Basic, or GNM, you are joining a legacy of excellence.

With Vision and Compassion,
Dr. Werlok Kharshiing

fields.title: Campus Safety
fields.content:
Campus Safety
Woodland Institute of Nursing places the highest priority on the safety, security, and well-being of its students, faculty, and staff. The Institute is committed to providing a safe, disciplined, and supportive learning environment where every individual can pursue academic and professional excellence without concern.

24/7 Security & Monitoring

The campus and hostel premises are secured by trained security personnel round the clock. Entry and exit points are monitored to ensure controlled access, and visitor movement is regulated through proper verification procedures.

Comprehensive Safety Measures

Safety measures include well-lit corridors, monitored common areas, and strict adherence to fire safety norms. Fire extinguishers and emergency response protocols are regularly inspected and maintained to meet safety standards.

Zero-Tolerance Policy

The institute enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy towards ragging, harassment, bullying, or any form of misconduct. Violations attract immediate disciplinary action as per institutional norms.

Grievance Redressal & Student Support

A structured grievance redressal mechanism is available to address student concerns confidentially and promptly, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Through proactive measures, continuous monitoring, and a culture of mutual respect and responsibility, Woodland Institute of Nursing ensures that campus safety remains an integral part of its institutional values.

fields.title: STUDENT ACTIVITIES
fields.content:
STUDENT ACTIVITIES & CO-CURRICULAR PARTICIPATION
Students are expected to actively participate in all academic, co-curricular and extracurricular activities organized by the Institute.
Educational trips will be arranged during the course to various Health Institutes and Centres inside and outside the State of Meghalaya. Students shall bear the full expenses of such trips. Free conveyance may be provided for short distances.
Hostel facilities include indoor games such as table tennis, carom, chess, etc. A playground is available for basketball, badminton and other outdoor sports. Students are encouraged to participate in inter-institute competitions.
The Student Nurses Association (SNA) conducts co-curricular activities such as academic seminars, symposiums, interactive sessions and other events from time to time to prepare students to become highly competent and confident nurses. Students may represent SNA Meghalaya at SNA Conferences held in other States.

fields.title: Location
fields.content:
LOCATION

Woodland Institute of Nursing is situated at Laitkor, about 10 Km from Shillong. The Institute commands a panoramic view of abundant flora and fauna. The farm land, cascading hills and inland waterways add to the beauty of the picturesque surroundings of Woodland Institute of Nursing.

Woodland Institute of Nursing is surrounded by hills and valleys. Not too far from the Institute are the beautiful peaks like Shillong Peak, Shillong View Point and ├Ång Syiem Sad Smit.

Laitkor is a beautiful place to live in, with its amazing climate. It is a peaceful and clean place full of trees and fresh air.

The environment here in Woodland Institute of Nursing is full of greenery, mountains, rivers and green fields. Its breeze and natural beauty create a warm and homely atmosphere where fellow-feeling and sharing are part of daily life. Anyone around here always has a smile to share.

Outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers can enjoy trekking, hiking, and many other activities in the surrounding scenic landscapes.

fields.title: Rules & Regulation for Students & Parents/Guardians
fields.content:
Rules & Regulations for Students & Parents
Rules & Regulations will be handed to each student and parents/guardians at the time of admission, which are strictly to be followed.
Students must maintain discipline and decorum within the campus and during clinical postings.
Attendance in theory and practical classes is compulsory as per institutional and university norms.
Students must wear prescribed uniform during clinical practice and official functions.
Respect towards faculty members, staff, patients, and fellow students is mandatory.
Damage to institute property will result in disciplinary action and recovery charges.
Mobile phones are not permitted during class hours and clinical duties.
Students must follow hostel rules and timings strictly.
Participation in academic, co-curricular and community activities is encouraged.
Any form of ragging is strictly prohibited and punishable as per UGC & INC guidelines.
Parents/Guardians are expected to cooperate with the institution in maintaining discipline.

fields.title: CONDUCT AND DISCIPLINE RULES FOR INSTITUTE AND HOSTEL
fields.content:
Institute Policy
Students are expected to maintain discipline, dignity and professionalism within the college premises at all times.
Students are not permitted to use mobile phones while in class or during clinical duty.
Students must maintain good communal harmony and interpersonal relationships.
Drugs, alcohol and other addictive substances are strictly prohibited.
Any student found guilty of ragging in any form will face strict disciplinary action.
Violation of rules will attract disciplinary action at the discretion of the college authority.
All decisions taken by the college authority shall be final and binding.
Hostel Policy
Hostel occupancy is compulsory. Hostel rules and regulations will be detailed at the time of allotment of hostel seat.
College and hostel premises are guarded by security personnel round the clock.

fields.title: MEDICAL FITNESS REQUIREMENT
fields.content:
MEDICAL FITNESS AND HEPATITIS B VACCINATION
Selected candidates will undergo a medical check-up before admission to the course. Students will be immunized against infectious diseases as and when necessary.
Students who are sick must stay in the designated sick room with due permission from the competent authority.
One room is allotted exclusively as a student sick room for medical care and observation.

fields.title: Faculty & Academic Leadership
fields.content:
Faculty & Academic Leadership
Woodland Nursing Institute is supported by a team of highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated faculty members who play a vital role in academic instruction, clinical supervision, mentoring, and professional development of students. Faculty members represent all major nursing disciplines and actively contribute to research, training, and community outreach programmes.

Professor cum Principal

Mrs. L. Kharbynngar Das

Specialisation: Medical Surgical Nursing

Vice Principals

Ms. Bakyntiew Mawkhiew ΓÇô Medical Surgical Nursing

Ms. Wanda S. Thma ΓÇô Child Health Nursing

Associate Professor

Ms. Suciancy Dkhar ΓÇô Medical Surgical Nursing

Assistant Professors

Medical Surgical, Community Health, Obstetrical & Gynaecological, and Mental Health Nursing specialists support academic and clinical instruction.

Lecturers, Tutors & Clinical Instructors

Lecturers, tutors, and clinical instructors provide continuous guidance, skill-based training, bedside supervision, and mentoring to ensure student competency and professional growth.

fields.title: Commitment to Excellence
fields.content:
Commitment to Excellence
Woodland Nursing Institute remains steadfast in its commitment to academic excellence, clinical competence, ethical nursing practice, and social responsibility.

By fostering professionalism, compassion, accountability, and lifelong learning, the institute continues to shape confident, capable, and future-ready nursing professionals dedicated to strengthening healthcare systems and improving quality of life for society at large.

fields.title: SCHOLARSHIP
fields.content:
SCHOLARSHIP AND BANK LOAN
  • Students can avail Merit Scholarships from professional organizations such as TNAI and the State Government (Annual income certificate of Parents/Guardian must be enclosed).
  • Students are eligible to apply for Educational Loans from recognized banks.
  • Students should open their Bank Accounts before admission.
Please ensure all required income and supporting documents are submitted at the time of application.

fields.title: Admission
fields.content:
Application Form for BSc Nursing
Please Note:
  • Self-attested copies of mark sheets must be submitted.
  • Medical fitness certificate required.
  • Character certificate required.
  • Migration certificate required.
  • Fees once paid are non-refundable.

fields.title: Student Welfare & Development
fields.content:
Student Welfare & Development

The institute emphasises holistic student welfare and professional development through structured academic guidance, personal support, and skill enhancement initiatives designed to prepare competent healthcare professionals.

  • Academic Mentoring: Continuous academic guidance and performance monitoring.
  • Counselling Support: Professional personal and career counselling services.
  • Co-Curricular Activities: Encouraging leadership, teamwork, and personality development.
  • Professional Development Programmes: Skill-building and career preparation initiatives.
  • Seminars & Workshops: Expert-led academic and practical training sessions.
  • Health Camps & Community Outreach: Promoting responsibility and public health awareness.
  • Professional Conferences: Exposure to advanced academic and healthcare practices.

fields.title: INSTRUCTIONAL FACILITIES
fields.content:
Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

The qualified nursing, medical and non-medical faculty of the Institute provides a high-quality programme of study. Methods of instruction include formal lectures, group discussions, laboratory sessions, field work and planned clinical experience under faculty guidance. Provision is also made for individual guidance and various clinical experiences.

  • A candidate must have a minimum of 80% attendance (irrespective of the kind of absence) in theory in each subject for appearing for examination.
  • A candidate must have 100% attendance in each of the practical areas before the award of degree.
  • Students will not be allowed to go home midway between the academic sessions, except in cases of emergency as per the PrincipalΓÇÖs decision.
  • A candidate must pass in internal and external examinations in each paper separately.
